title: Modal Lifecycle
prompt:
Write `createModal()` that RETURNS an object with:

- `open(trigger, root)` — marks the modal open, remembers `trigger` as the element to restore focus to later, stores `root` as the modal content, and returns "opened"
- `close()` — marks it closed and returns "closed"; if it was not open, returns "already-closed"
- `restoreFocus()` — returns and clears the remembered trigger (undefined if none)
- `isOpen()` — boolean state

Opening twice without closing returns "already-open" and must NOT overwrite the remembered trigger.

tests.name: open/close cycle with focus restore
tests.hint: Keep state, previousFocus, and root in the closure.

tests.name: restores focus to the opener
guards double open and double close
tests.hint: The opener remembered by the FIRST open must survive the rejected second open.
